audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart is 'Urgot' in all seven rows on both layers, but the packet levelChart ends in 'Skill' at 2+ items, and whys[6] already says the lane levels to a skill matchup late. Win rate is 50.86% over 2214 games, which does not support Urgot owning every stage.
audit.why: The final row contradicts both the packet chart and the prose sitting next to it.
audit.corrected: Flip the last row (win[6] and phases[6].side) to 'Skill' so the chart matches packet and prose. Earlier rows stay Urgot: his ranged poke and shred genuinely own levels 1-6 into a melee with no gap-closer beyond a 300-range Decisive Strike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text treats Fear Beyond Death as a flat execute with no timing detail, and gives no cooldown for it.
audit.why: Riot's text: R impales the first champion hit at 2500 range and only executes below a health threshold. Cooldown is 100/85/70. That number is what makes 'bait it then commit' actionable.
audit.corrected: State the 100s rank-1 cooldown and the fact that above the threshold it does not execute, so the all-in window is the R downtime.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction of this matchup is never stated: Urgot's Corrosive Charge and Purge both slow, and Garen's Decisive Strike breaks free of all slows affecting him on cast. Every page instead implies his slows stop the gap-close.
audit.why: Riot's Garen Q text: 'gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him.' That directly answers Urgot's two slow tools. Disdain (E) is his real engage/disengage at 16s rank 1 / 14s rank 5, and it shields him.
audit.corrected: Q purges his slows and closes the gap regardless; the thing that actually beats you is Purge DPS plus Echoing Flames leg shots during the silence window, and Disdain hurling you back out.

audit.why: 14s is rank 5 only; at rank 1 it is 16s, which is the number that matters in lane.
packet.suspectNames flags 'Land Corrosive Charge' as a probable wrong name. It is a false positive — Corrosive Charge is Urgot's real Q per the kit file.
audit.corrected: No name change needed; the line was reworded only for accuracy about the slow, not the name.

edits.before: Urgot's Corrosive Charge plus Purge shreds you the moment you Q in; his passive leg shots and W attack-speed out-DPS your silence trade even when you close the gap.
edits.after: Corrosive Charge slows, but Decisive Strike breaks all slows on cast, so you still reach him; what beats you is Purge and Echoing Flames leg shots out-DPSing your silence window.

edits.before: Fear Beyond Death is a hard execute: below the threshold he flips you and any nearby ally can pile on, and it also negates the value of your own R.
edits.after: Fear Beyond Death impales at 2500 range and only executes below the threshold — it is up every 100s at rank 1, so bait it, then all-in while it is down.

edits.before: Land Corrosive Charge to slow your Q gap-close
edits.after: Land Corrosive Charge before your Q comes up

edits.before: Track Urgot’s Disdain (Flip) (14s): His engage. Bait it, then spin. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Disdain (E) is 16s at rank 1: it shields him and hurls you away. Bait it, then Q in — Q breaks his slows.

notes: Level-chart flip proposed as one group (content win[6] + full phases[6].side) — only the last row disagrees with the packet chart. packet.suspectNames flagged 'Land Corrosive Charge' as a wrong ability name; that is a FALSE POSITIVE, Corrosive Charge is correct per the kit. Left wants.you[2] ('Use Q silence to stop his Purge mid-channel') untouched: Riot's Purge text does not say whether it is interruptible by silence, so I could not verify it — recorded in unverified. Also left the diff/diffRating (HARD, 8/10) alone despite a 50.86% win rate; that is a champion-level judgement call, see questionsForUser.
